mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and 75 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. It is a great night for stargazing; if you look to the northwest near Verona High School at 3:35 AM, you can spot the International Space Station as it passes halfway up the sky on its way toward Fitchburg.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round access for everyone. Also, Century School Park has a beautiful new art installation called Tai Chi Animal Frolics, featuring wooden animal sculptures carved from a fallen ash tree.

Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the local fun continues with the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol Square and live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, don't miss trivia nights starting next week at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly report, on August 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle accident on South Nine Mound Road where a driver struck a parked car and was cited for inattentive driving.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
